svg.aria-label: Dreaming: memory consolidation between epochs, run separately for red and blue. 1 Gather verified development runs; holdout and indeterminate runs are refused (in v0.1). 2 Dream: batch-synthesize lessons (v0.4). 3 Propose a new version linked to its parent and its evidence runs (in v0.1). 4 Gate: regression tests and operator approval; stale parents are refused (approval in v0.1, regression gate v0.4). 5 Promote, with rollback to the prior version (v0.4). A wall separates the two lanes.
